node.title: XML::XPath matching different file extension
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext:
Hi there Monks!

I have this line in my code and I am trying to see if there is a way to add more than one file match in this line, the files comes as "*.txt", "*.TXT", "*.png", "*.PNG".
It breaks if in this line the file extension is "*.TXT" instead of "*.txt". my @files = $zip->membersMatching( '.*\.txt' );
Thanks for looking!
